TEXT.English: Declare a regional Crusade against every non-Christian nation with a city in this region, including Independents and their required war allies. All council members are bound, including No and Abstain voters. Coalition members end their wars with one another, cannot declare war on each other, and receive temporary military passage. Separate peace, capitulation that evades the war, and peace events are blocked. When the Crusade ends, all coalition wars against its targets end and temporary passage expires. Regional combat victories earn 25 gold each, up to 10 rewards per nation. The reminder includes those rewards plus regional pillage and city-capture gold. Conquered cities in the target region are assigned, in order, to a Christian or extinct nation with a historical flip claim; the nearest neighboring Christian nation; or a dedicated Independent Crusader state. The conqueror cannot choose to keep, raze or relocate the settlement. Extinct claimants return as Christian Holy State kingdoms and join the coalition; other recipients join it too.

TEXT.English: The Apostolic Palace is founded only by the Papal State event in the city of Rome; it cannot be built. Rome must contain Christianity. A Christian owner may cede Rome to a new Papal State or refuse at a repeated diplomatic cost. An owner using Theocracy and Holy State may instead turn their entire nation into the Papal State. Independent Rome flips automatically. Non-Christian or barbarian ownership, Tolerance and State Atheism prevent the event.[PARAGRAPH:1]The Papal State cannot change its state religion or legitimation civic unless it adopts Tolerance, and cannot adopt State Atheism. Tolerance disables the Palace, its councils and its bonuses. Returning to Christian religious rule restores them. The Palace is inactive if the Papal State loses Rome.[PARAGRAPH:1]Christian councils meet approximately every 30 turns, scaled to game speed, with 1-3 turn capital-distance courier delays and a live public tally. All members must follow passed resolutions; voting offers only Yes, No and Abstain. Crusades, leagues, truces, pilgrimage, relief, scholarship and religious reform have explicit effects and thresholds. See each proposal for its exact obligations. Crusade conquests are settled under historical claims, neighboring Christian nations and the dedicated Independent Crusader States.[PARAGRAPH:1]The Papal State has ten turns to recover a lost Rome; failure dissolves it, releases its remaining cities as Independents and disbands its army. No new Papal founding event occurs while a Papal State survives. Every founding or restoration starts with a strong AI preference for Theocracy and Holy State. Once the world reaches the Modern era, this preference fades over 30 turns at Normal speed. A modern restoration restarts the full preference and its fade. Human civic choices remain player-controlled.

TEXT.English: Christianity has taken root in Rome. The Pope requests temporal sovereignty over the city and offers to establish the Apostolic Palace there. You may cede Rome to a new Papal State, or refuse and receive a stacking -2 relations penalty from every other Christian nation. These refusal penalties disappear when you accept the request (including becoming the Papal State) or lose Rome. Refusal postpones the request for %d1 turns. Ceding your last city can end your nation. A nation already using Holy State and Theocracy may instead become the Papal State, retaining its territory and player control. The Papal State is bound to its state religion and legitimation civic while it is not tolerant, and can never adopt State Atheism. Tolerance disables the Palace and all its effects; returning to Christian religious rule restores them.

TEXT.English: The Power of the Holy See: while the Papal State controls an active Apostolic Palace, Rome gains +2 base [ICON_GOLD] per foreign city containing Christianity, amplified by gold modifiers. Papal cities containing Christianity gain +50% city defense; bombardment still applies. Both bonuses stop when the Palace is inactive, including under Tolerance or after losing Rome.
TEXT.French: Le pouvoir du Saint-Siège : tant que l’État pontifical contrôle un Palais apostolique actif, Rome gagne +2 [ICON_GOLD] de base par ville étrangère abritant le christianisme, amplifiés par les modificateurs d’or. Les villes pontificales chrétiennes gagnent +50 % de défense urbaine ; le bombardement reste applicable. Ces bonus cessent si le Palais est inactif, notamment sous la Tolérance ou après la perte de Rome.
TEXT.German: Die Macht des Heiligen Stuhls: Solange der Kirchenstaat den aktiven Apostolischen Palast kontrolliert, erhält Rom +2 Basis-[ICON_GOLD] je ausländischer Stadt mit Christentum, verstärkt durch Goldmodifikatoren. Päpstliche Städte mit Christentum erhalten +50% Stadtverteidigung; Bombardierung wirkt weiterhin. Beide Boni entfallen bei inaktivem Palast, auch unter Toleranz oder nach dem Verlust Roms.
TEXT.Italian: Il potere della Santa Sede: finché lo Stato Pontificio controlla un Palazzo Apostolico attivo, Roma riceve +2 [ICON_GOLD] di base per ogni città straniera con il cristianesimo, amplificati dai modificatori dell’oro. Le città pontificie cristiane ricevono +50% alla difesa cittadina; il bombardamento resta efficace. Entrambi i bonus cessano quando il Palazzo è inattivo, anche con Tolleranza o dopo la perdita di Roma.
TEXT.Spanish: El poder de la Santa Sede: mientras los Estados Pontificios controlen un Palacio Apostólico activo, Roma obtiene +2 [ICON_GOLD] de base por ciudad extranjera con cristianismo, amplificados por los modificadores de oro. Las ciudades pontificias cristianas obtienen +50% de defensa urbana; el bombardeo sigue siendo eficaz. Ambos beneficios cesan cuando el Palacio está inactivo, incluso bajo Tolerancia o tras perder Roma.

TEXT.English: Rome has been lost! Recapture it within %d1 turns or the Papal State will dissolve. Its remaining cities will become independent and its army will disband.
TEXT.French: Rome est perdue ! Reprenez-la sous %d1 tours ou l’État pontifical sera dissous. Ses villes restantes deviendront indépendantes et son armée sera dissoute.
TEXT.German: Rom ist verloren! Erobert es innerhalb von %d1 Runden zurück, sonst wird der Kirchenstaat aufgelöst. Seine verbleibenden Städte werden unabhängig und seine Armee wird aufgelöst.
TEXT.Italian: Roma è perduta! Riconquistatela entro %d1 turni o lo Stato Pontificio sarà sciolto. Le città rimaste diventeranno indipendenti e il suo esercito sarà sciolto.
TEXT.Spanish: ¡Roma se ha perdido! Reconquístala en %d1 turnos o los Estados Pontificios se disolverán. Sus ciudades restantes se independizarán y su ejército se disolverá.

TEXT.English: The Papal State has dissolved after failing to recover Rome within ten turns. Its remaining cities have become independent.
TEXT.French: L’État pontifical a été dissous faute d’avoir repris Rome sous dix tours. Ses villes restantes sont devenues indépendantes.
TEXT.German: Der Kirchenstaat wurde aufgelöst, da er Rom nicht innerhalb von zehn Runden zurückerobert hat. Seine verbleibenden Städte sind nun unabhängig.
TEXT.Italian: Lo Stato Pontificio è stato sciolto dopo non aver riconquistato Roma entro dieci turni. Le città rimaste sono diventate indipendenti.
TEXT.Spanish: Los Estados Pontificios se han disuelto al no recuperar Roma en diez turnos. Sus ciudades restantes se han independizado.

TEXT.English: The Papal State has ten turns to recover a lost Rome; failure dissolves it, releases its remaining cities as Independents and disbands its army. No new Papal founding event occurs while a Papal State survives. Every founding or restoration starts with a strong AI preference for Theocracy and Holy State. Once the world reaches the Modern era, this preference fades over 30 turns at Normal speed. A modern restoration restarts the full preference and its fade. Human civic choices remain player-controlled.
TEXT.French: L’État pontifical dispose de dix tours pour reprendre Rome ; en cas d’échec, il est dissous, ses villes restantes deviennent indépendantes et son armée est dissoute. Aucun nouvel événement de fondation n’a lieu tant qu’il survit. Chaque fondation ou restauration donne à l’IA une forte préférence pour Théocratie et État sacré. Dès l’ère moderne mondiale, elle diminue sur 30 tours en vitesse normale. Une restauration moderne rétablit cette préférence et relance son déclin. Les joueurs humains gardent le choix de leurs doctrines.
TEXT.German: Der Kirchenstaat hat zehn Runden, um das verlorene Rom zurückzuerobern. Bei Misserfolg wird er aufgelöst, seine übrigen Städte werden unabhängig und seine Armee wird aufgelöst. Solange er existiert, gibt es kein neues Gründungsereignis. Jede Gründung oder Wiederherstellung gibt der KI eine starke Vorliebe für Theokratie und Heiligen Staat. Sobald die Welt die Moderne erreicht, klingt sie bei normaler Geschwindigkeit über 30 Runden ab. Eine moderne Wiederherstellung erneuert die volle Vorliebe und startet ihr Abklingen neu. Menschliche Spieler entscheiden weiterhin selbst über ihre Staatsformen.
TEXT.Italian: Lo Stato Pontificio ha dieci turni per riconquistare Roma; in caso di fallimento viene sciolto, le città rimaste diventano indipendenti e il suo esercito viene sciolto. Non si verifica un nuovo evento di fondazione finché sopravvive. Ogni fondazione o restaurazione conferisce all’IA una forte preferenza per Teocrazia e Stato sacro. Quando il mondo raggiunge l’era moderna, questa preferenza svanisce in 30 turni a velocità normale. Una restaurazione moderna ripristina la preferenza completa e ne riavvia il declino. I giocatori umani mantengono il controllo delle proprie scelte civiche.
TEXT.Spanish: Los Estados Pontificios tienen diez turnos para recuperar Roma; si fracasan, se disuelven, sus ciudades restantes se independizan y su ejército se disuelve. No se produce otro evento de fundación mientras sobrevivan. Cada fundación o restauración otorga a la IA una fuerte preferencia por Teocracia y Estado sagrado. Cuando el mundo alcanza la era moderna, esta preferencia desaparece en 30 turnos a velocidad normal. Una restauración moderna recupera la preferencia completa y reinicia su disminución. Los jugadores humanos mantienen el control de sus opciones cívicas.
